Charming Three-Bedroom Villa Near Emba Village, Paphos This beautifully presented three-bedroom villa offers a perfect blend of comfort and traditional charm. Set in a peaceful location just on the outskirts of the traditional Cypriot village of Emba, the home features a spacious outdoor area ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Emba is one of the largest and most historic villages in the Paphos district, known for its tranquil atmosphere and authentic Cypriot character. Nestled among citrus orchards and winding lanes, the village borders several other charming communities, including Mesogi, Tala, Kissonerga, Tremithousa, and Chloraka. The name "Emba" is believed to derive from the Greek word for "enter," likely due to its location at a key entrance point into Paphos from the north and west. The heart of Emba is home to both a new and a historic Greek Orthodox Church, both dedicated to St. Andrew (Apostle Andreas). Each year on November 30th, the village comes alive with a religious celebration in his honor. Throughout the village, you’ll find a few traditional tavernas, small shops, and glimpses of everyday village life—such as locals gathered on wooden chairs outside cafés, enjoying the quiet evening hours. Despite its rural charm, Emba is just minutes away from Paphos Old Town and the coastal area of Chloraka, where all essential amenities like supermarkets, pharmacies, banks, petrol stations, restaurants, and bars are easily accessible. Inside the villa, you’ll find a bright and tastefully decorated open-plan living and dining area with sliding glass doors leading to a terrace that overlooks the lush garden—perfect for enjoying the serene surroundings. The fully equipped kitchen sits adjacent to the dining space, which comfortably seats six guests. Upstairs, the villa offers three well-appointed bedrooms: a master bedroom with a double bed and en-suite bathroom, a second double bedroom, and a twin room—ideal for families or groups. The ground floor provides direct access to the private garden, offering additional space to unwind. The living area features a comfortable sofa, high-speed wireless internet, and a flat-screen smart TV with a TV box for your entertainment needs. Title Deeds Available.
